name: app.ridedesk/bookings
title: RideDesk Bookings
description: Quote and book airport transfers on a RideDesk operator's live desk. Agents never set prices.

tenant_domain.description: The operator's RideDesk domain: <workspace>.ridedesk.app or their verified custom domain. Requires the operator's AI agents add-on; connect via OAuth (staff consent) or an API key from Settings.
